title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: hyperlinks in Edge warn and block notifications (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The notification customisation guidance omits Microsoft's requirement to select the Devices location only. The statement that PowerShell documents no Endpoint DLP notification-content parameter is also too broad: Microsoft documents custom policy-tip localisation through PowerShell.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Scope: Users; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Endpoint DLP warn and block notifications in Edge can show a hyperlink when the rule triggers.
claims.quote: Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser; When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink.

claims.quote: the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink.

claims.claim: The notification can have a customised message.

claims.quote: direct users to a specific resource or a repository for more specific instruction (e.g. internal policy SharePoint site).

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP extends Microsoft Purview DLP protection to onboarded devices.
claims.quote: Microsoft Endpoint DLP allows you to monitor onboarded Windows 10, and Windows 11 and onboarded macOS devices running any of the three latest released versions. Once a device is onboarded, DLP detects when sensitive items are used and shared.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what happens to existing notifications when this feature arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP Edge notification hyperlink default existing notifications Get Support Chrome Firefox; "Endpoint DLP" "notification" "default" hyperlink. Read roadmap, DLP policy reference and Edge DLP documentation; none states this feature's arrival behaviour.

claims.where: What's changing: Devices notification options; controls[1].note; Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: A policy scoped to the Devices location offers custom notification title, content and a Get Support hyperlink.
claims.quote: If you selected Devices only, you get all the same options ... plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink in the form of a Get Support button that appears on the Windows 10/11 device.
claims.fix: Change the introductory clause in What's changing to 'The DLP policy reference documents that when Devices only is selected, rules offer'. Change Scope's prerequisite to 'devices onboarded to Endpoint DLP and a DLP policy scoped to the Devices location only'. Add 'when Devices only is selected' to controls[1].note and its rendered table note. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-policy-reference.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The notification hyperlink must be a resolvable URL.
claims.quote: The hyperlink must be a resolvable URL, and it's abstracted behind a selectable control.

claims.claim: The hyperlink sits behind a selectable control.
claims.quote: The hyperlink must be a resolvable URL, and it's abstracted behind a selectable control.

claims.claim: Under Block with override, users can proceed using the Ok button on the Microsoft Edge notification.
claims.quote: Block with override: This option acts as a standard block but permits users to bypass it. By clicking the 'Allow' button on the toast notification or the 'Ok' button on the Microsoft Edge notification, users can proceed.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not yet specify how this notification hyperlink renders in Edge.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "hyperlink" "Edge"; Endpoint DLP Edge notification hyperlink default existing notifications Get Support Chrome Firefox. Read DLP policy reference, Edge security and Edge DLP pages; Windows Get Support is described, but Edge-specific hyperlink rendering is not.

claims.claim: Rule actions determine whether service-domain and browser activities are audited, blocked with override or blocked.
claims.quote: When you configure the Allow/Block cloud service domains and the Unallowed browsers list ... you can configure the policy action to Audit only, Block with override, or Block the activity.

claims.claim: Custom policy tips show for the most restrictive rule.
claims.quote: Custom Policy Tips show for the most restrictive rule, not necessarily the rule that's performing the restriction.

claims.where: Scope: Roles; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The DLP deployment guide requires membership in one of the five listed role groups to create and deploy policies.
claims.quote: The account you use to create and deploy policies must be a member of one of these role groups: Compliance administrator; Compliance data administrator; Information Protection; Information Protection Admin; Security administrator.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP requires device onboarding for the described device protection.
claims.quote: Once a device is onboarded, DLP detects when sensitive items are used and shared.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches the Service domain and browser activities Block with override control.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies ... Edit policy ... Customize advanced DLP rules ... Actions > Audit or restrict activities on Windows device ... Service domain and browser activities to Block with override.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule -Identity <rule> -EndpointDlpRestrictions @(@{"Setting"="<Setting>"; "Value"="Warn"}) configures an Endpoint DLP restriction.
claims.quote: The EndpointDlpRestrictions parameter specifies the restricted endpoints for Endpoint DLP ... @(@{"Setting"="<Setting>"; "Value"="<Value>}", ...). The available values for <Value> are: Audit, Block, Ignore, or Warn.

claims.claim: EndpointDlpRestrictions requires Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Note: This parameter requires membership in the Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator roles in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Block and Warn values for EndpointDlpRestrictions also require NotifyUser.
claims.quote: When you use the values Block or Warn in this parameter, also need to use the NotifyUser parameter.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; rendered controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Data loss prevention > Policies > policy > Edit policy > Customize advanced DLP rules > rule reaches the rule containing notification customisation.
claims.quote: If you selected Devices only ... the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink ...; the cited unauthorized-data-sharing procedure gives Policies > policy > Edit policy > Customize advanced DLP rules > rule.
claims.fix: Keep the path: its entry steps are documented on the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/endpoint-dlp-create-policy-unauthorized-data-sharing. claims.where: controls[1].api; rendered controls table; Open questions
claims.claim: No documented automation operation configures the Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink.
claims.quote: Searched: Set-DlpComplianceRule Endpoint DLP custom notification title content hyperlink PowerShell NotifyPolicyTipUrl; "Endpoint DLP" "notification" "hyperlink" API PowerShell title content. Read Set-DlpComplianceRule and DLP policy reference; URL parameter is Exchange-only.

claims.claim: Learn supplies no UI step label for the notification customisation control inside the rule.
claims.quote: Searched the fetched DLP policy reference for custom notification, title, content, hyperlink and Get Support; read Policy tips and user notifications configuration options and the cited rule-edit procedure. Neither supplies a further Endpoint notification setting label.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule documents no parameter for Endpoint DLP notification title, content or hyperlink.
claims.quote: You can localize your custom policy tips by using the Set-DlpComplianceRule -NotifyPolicyTipCustomTextTranslations cmdlet.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with 'In Security & Compliance PowerShell, the Set-DlpComplianceRule reference documents no parameter specifically for the Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink; its NotifyPolicyTipUrl parameter is described for the popup dialog in Exchange workloads.' The Devices notification section documents policy-tip localisation with NotifyPolicyTipCustomTextTranslations, so remove the broader title/content absence. Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-policy-reference and https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/set-dlpcompliancerule.

claims.claim: NotifyPolicyTipUrl is documented for the popup dialog in Exchange workloads.
claims.quote: The NotifyPolicyTipUrl parameter specifies the URL in the popup dialog for Exchange workloads.

claims.claim: The roadmap and Learn do not specify whether this Edge notification-hyperlink change applies to Chrome and Firefox extensions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "hyperlink" "Chrome" "Firefox". Read roadmap, DLP policy reference and search passages from Chrome/Firefox extension and endpoint settings pages; browser protection is described, but this Edge hyperlink change is not extended to those browsers.

claims.quote: Rules ... Policy tips and user notifications configuration options ... If you selected Devices only ... the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink in the form of a Get Support button.
